title: Track C5 migration usage consistently
summary: C5 2012 migration now emits standard cloud migration telemetry events for feature uptake, completion, and abort tracking, plus a one-time upgrade backfill for historical usage.
key_points: Adds feature-uptake and completed-migration telemetry events aligned with QuickBooks migration
Emits abort migration event for failed migrations
Includes one-time per-company upgrade backfill for historical completed migrations
Uses standard telemetry tags and reporting integration
No changes to existing C5 telemetry behavior
